open_points.subject: StoredValue/value-bytes ownership for captured trial cases
open_points.text: "StoredValue M21 and value bytes are written by whichever module produces or receives the value — `flows` for constants, `functions` for trial values, `runs` for flow inputs and function outputs, `effects` for service outputs" / "For a capture `runs` copies the spooled input files into the content-addressed area through `store` and passes their digests; `functions` writes the TrialCase that names them."
open_points.question: When capture creates trial inputs from a failed run (especially file fixtures), which module owns writing the StoredValue records and bytes: `runs`, `functions`, or both?
options: `runs` writes bytes and StoredValue records; `functions` only links them in TrialCase
`runs` writes bytes; `functions` writes StoredValue records and TrialCase
`functions` owns all trial-value persistence; `runs` only supplies source references
open_points.default_guess: `runs` copies file bytes; `functions` creates/links trial-case StoredValues using those digests.

open_points.subject: NodeExecution ownership and invariant enforcement
open_points.text: "NodeExecution M23 is written by `effects` for the record that concludes an operation element ... and by `runs` for every other record."
open_points.question: Who is the single owner of global NodeExecution invariants (exactly-once record per concluded attempt, field-shape checks, and ordering guarantees) when two modules write the same record type?
options: `runs` owns all NodeExecution invariants; `effects` must call a `runs` capability
`effects` and `runs` each enforce invariants for their subset
`store` enforces cross-cutting invariants (uniqueness/order), while writers enforce subset-specific content
open_points.default_guess: `store` enforces uniqueness/order constraints; each writer enforces content rules for its branch.

open_points.subject: Surface masking dependency for execution class
open_points.text: "The class of an execution for masking (A07 rule 5) is computed by `surface` from the records it returns." / "computing an execution's class from the records it returns and the classes `bindings.read_binding` declares (A07 rule 5)."
open_points.question: Is execution-class masking intended to be derivable from trace/value records alone, or must `surface` depend on `bindings` lookups at read time?
options: Derive only from NodeExecution/TrialExecution + referenced value/file classes
Always include binding lookup for operation executions
Use records first; lookup binding only when output-class facts are missing
open_points.default_guess: Use records when sufficient; call `bindings.read_binding` only for operation executions where output-class context is required.
